details: BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF has acquired an additional $900 million in Bitcoin, a significant sum exceeding weekly network production. This substantial institutional investment has notably increased the odds of Bitcoin (BTC) reaching the $80,000 mark in April, now estimated between 71.5% and 76.5%, signaling strong institutional demand.
title: BlackRock's $900M Bitcoin Buy Boosts $80K Price Odds

details: As of April 24, Ethereum (ETH) is trading between $2,300 and $2,400, encountering significant technical resistance. Analysts observe a "squeeze pattern" with tightening volatility and a consolidation phase since late 2025. A decisive close above $2,400 on strong volume could propel ETH towards $2,500 or even $2,800, supported by ongoing ETF inflows and network upgrades.
title: Ethereum Coiled at $2,400, Facing Key Resistance

details: A substantial $9.87 billion worth of Bitcoin and Ethereum options contracts expired on April 24, marking April's largest monthly settlement. Both BTC and ETH traded above their respective max pain levels at expiry ($72,000 for BTC and $2,200 for ETH). Ethereum, in particular, exhibited a stronger call bias, suggesting a bullish sentiment among derivatives traders.
title: Nearly $10B Bitcoin & Ethereum Options Expire, BTC & ETH Above Max Pain

details: Morgan Stanley Investment Management has introduced a new government money market fund, the Stablecoin Reserves Portfolio (MSNXX), designed to help stablecoin issuers hold reserve assets in compliance with the GENIUS Act requirements. This initiative by a major traditional financial institution indicates a growing adaptation to and integration with the digital asset ecosystem.
title: Morgan Stanley Launches Stablecoin Reserves Fund Aligned with GENIUS Act
